creator: millee.md
title: 20-item legal/compliance checklist to have Claude add to your app so it does not get sued

tools.name: Claude
tools.detail: Title card: '20 things to have Claude do so your app doesn't get sued'

claims: Doing these 20 things keeps a vibe-coded app out of legal trouble
Whole list delivered in under 26 seconds
how_to_steps: 17. Get age consent if you collect kids' data
18. Add an unsubscribe link to your emails
19. License any fonts and images you use
20. Add a data deletion request option
on_screen_only: Title card: '20 things to have Claude do so your app doesn't get sued (In under 26 seconds)'
Numbered two-column list fills in progressively with a running timer (00:01.06 ... 00:24.93)
Item 8 reads 'Audit third-party SDKs' (transcript garbles it as 'SC cases')

relevance.why: Every item is a real pre-launch obligation for a founder shipping consumer apps; most are cheap to do and ignoring them is a real liability.

implement_score.why: Turn the 20 items into a Claude Code skill/slash command (/legal-audit) that checks the repo and generates missing pages, alt text, contrast fixes, unsubscribe links and a deletion flow; a few hours once, reusable on every app.

verify: AI-generated privacy/ToS/refund policies still need a jurisdiction check (GDPR, CCPA, COPPA for kids' data, FTC on fake reviews/unsupported claims)
Accessibility items should be measured against WCAG 2.x AA, not just 'fixed'
Cookie consent banner requirements differ by region; may be unnecessary for US-only apps without tracking
